title: Running files and modules

spans.text: Run a Python file from the terminal and read arguments with sys.argv. Starting a module with python -m helps package-relative imports work correctly.

spans.code:
import sys

print('arguments:', sys.argv[1:])
# python -m package.module
arguments: ['first', 'second'] when invoked with those two arguments.

spans.text: python -m runs a module in its package context.

spans.title: Important tip
spans.text: Command-line arguments arrive as text; validate and convert them before use.
